svg.title: One agent action, end to end in warden
svg.desc: The model asks for rm /bin/ls. agentd sees only that string, forks a child and labels it as an agent. The label is inherited by sh and then rm. When rm calls unlink, the kernel's dispatch copies and normalizes the path, cap_check finds no write scope on /bin, records the attempt in the audit log and returns ECAPDENIED.
